learning_outcomes.text: Draft reports and prepare preliminary projects.
Apply technical and administrative legislation for project execution.
Understand the basic principles governing chemical process equipment and effluent treatment systems and their influence on pollution prevention and sustainable development.
Know pollution prevention methods and environmental management.

syllabus_topics: Topic 1. Characterization of natural and contaminated waters.
Topic 2. Treatment of contaminated water. Water line.
Unit 3. Management of urban and industrial solid waste
Topic 6. Management of urban solid waste.
Unit 4. Environmental management instruments in industry
Evaluation and relationship of physical-chemical parameters that characterize the degree of contamination of a synthetic wastewater: Determination of Chemical Oxygen Demand (COD).
assessment_rules: A written test (NPE) accounts for 60% of the grade and requires a minimum score of 5/10. This component is recoverable via another written test. A second written test (NPP) accounts for 25%. Individual assignments or projects (NT) account for 15%. The NPP and NT components are recoverable via a written test. No minimum score is specified for NPP and NT.
